log.note: rotating check 2026-10-06T08:01:21Z, 50 walks run from 73 onward in the rotation: caption-pick-answers-at-once-walk failing. This is a slice, not a sweep: the rest of the set is unchecked.

Reproduced: 3 of ~22 plain runs froze 497-501ms at step 10 (the second click that opens a caption for typing). Sampled a failing run: the walk harness's own window watcher thread sat ~394ms in SLSConnectionSynchronizeSLSCATransaction (CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo) holding the WindowServer connection lock, while the main thread sat ~384ms in SLSConnectionSetLastSLSCATransaction waiting for it: a lock standoff that ends at a ~500ms timeout. Every public window list call does that sync (checked in SkyLight's disassembly), so the walk was right and the app was not at fault: the harness made the freeze, no person ever meets it.

Fixed in PlaytestHarness.watchForWindowsOverThePerson: the 50Hz look now runs on a main run loop timer (common modes) through sendWindowsBehindThePerson, whose time is already left out of the meter. 25 runs after: no half-second freeze, per-step timings unchanged; passed many times in a row. focus-drill --check + this walk all clean (0 covered). section-fold-motion, select-click-perf, a-long-captioned-recording, an-editing-session walks pass. test.sh green.

left rough: step 26 of caption-pick-answers-at-once-walk (picking the first caption again after the canvas) reads 47-75ms and once 84ms against its 80ms line, 1 run in 25. Near the line, not a freeze; did not earn a task. If it shows up in a sweep again, file it then.

caption-pick-answers-at-once-walk's 500ms freezes were the walk harness, not the app: its window watcher read the window list from its own thread and stalled the main thread's frame commit on a WindowServer lock until a ~500ms timeout. Watcher now looks from the main thread (8f034c7b). Walk 25 runs after: no freeze, timings unchanged; focus-drill clean; timing walks pass; test.sh green.
